data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'heah' meaning 'high' and 'dun' meaning 'hill' or 'fort'. The name Henderson is of Anglo-Saxon origin and translates to 'strong, hard ruler'. The name has historical significance as a surname for Scottish clans and a given name in the English-speaking world. The name Henderson carries the meaning “Strong, hard ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Henderson usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, hard ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Henderson is of Scottish and Irish origin, and is a common surname in both countries. It is derived from the Gaelic name Mac Henderson, which means 'son of Henderson'. In Scotland, the name is often spelled as 'Henderson' or 'McHenderson', while in Ireland it is more commonly spelled as 'Henderson' or 'O'Henderson'. Today, the name is found in many parts of the world, particularly in countries with a significant Scottish or Irish diaspora. The name has also gained popularity as a given name in some English-speaking countries.
